body:
The kit's trunk push is off, so finished parts wait on their branches and you do not see their fixes on this page (the full-width phone bar, pictures, read marks, tabs).

Checked (tests rerun by a separate check, red on the old code): CL20, CL13, CL12, CL14, CL11, CL9, CL21; CL10's latest is being checked now.

On yes I merge them one at a time in this order: CL20, CL13, CL12, CL14, CL11, CL9, CL10, CL21. Before each: main merged in, all test suites pass, nothing on WHAT-NOT-TO-BREAK removed. Then I rebuild this page and republish it. A part that fails stays on its branch and I tell you.

This question was a comment under Ask the orchestrator (02:07); it belonged here.
default_option: Not yet: keep them on their branches
options: Yes: merge each checked part, then republish
Not yet: keep them on their branches
title: Merge the checked cl parts into the kit's main?
